title: How does event handling work in React, and why should you pass a function reference instead of invoking it?
expectedConcepts: Passing function reference vs immediate invocation onClick={handleClick} vs onClick={handleClick()}
Passing arguments with arrow functions onClick={() => handleDelete(id)}
hints: What happens if you write parentheses () right after the function name in onClick?
How does an arrow function delay execution until the click actually happens?

codingExercise.instruction: Attach a click handler to the button that alerts the passed title without executing on render.
